note: 60 INVENTED lessons (20 usable, 20 marginal, 20 not usable) written to mirror the shapes the research doc describes. No line comes from a real memory store. Rubric: usable = a future agent in the project could act on it without the original conversation; marginal = right topic, but the fix or the context is missing; not usable = narration, a fragment that refers to something outside itself, or wrong. tests/electron/lessonSubstance.test.ts asserts the gate's keep rate per class, so a later change that regresses the gate fails there. This documents the mechanism; it is NOT a measurement of real-world precision (the research doc's single-rater study found 67% recall at the keep bar).

lessons.label: usable
lessons.content: Problem: `npm ci` leaves no Electron binary because the tool shell sets NPM_CONFIG_IGNORE_SCRIPTS=true. → Fix: prefix the install with NPM_CONFIG_IGNORE_SCRIPTS=false.

lessons.label: usable
lessons.content: On Windows, `fs.rename` over a file that another process holds open fails with EPERM, so write to a temp file in the same folder and rename it after the handle is closed.

lessons.label: usable
lessons.content: Never call `app.quit()` from the `will-quit` handler: it re-enters the quit sequence and the app hangs.

lessons.label: usable

lessons.label: usable

lessons.label: usable

lessons.label: usable
lessons.content: Problem: ECONNRESET from the relay after about 60 s idle. → Fix: the load balancer closes idle sockets at 60 s, so send a ping frame every 25 s from `relayClient.ts`.

lessons.label: usable
lessons.content: The installer must not list running processes to close the app, because endpoint security reads that as discovery; ask the window to close itself instead.

lessons.label: usable

lessons.label: usable
lessons.content: Problem: `git worktree remove --force` deleted the real node_modules folder. → Fix: remove the junction with `cmd /c rmdir` first, because the recursive delete follows junctions.

lessons.label: usable

lessons.label: usable

lessons.label: usable
lessons.content: Checking `isWritable()` before `memoryWrite` is not enough: locked memory throws from `assertWritable`, so catch that error and pause the pass.

lessons.label: usable

lessons.label: usable

lessons.label: usable
lessons.content: In PowerShell 5.1 `git commit -m @'...'@` passes the message as pathspecs; write it to a file and use `git commit -F`.

lessons.label: usable
lessons.content: Always run the full suite before calling a change done: new modules that import `fs` have broken unrelated suites before.

lessons.label: usable
lessons.content: Problem: TLS handshake fails behind the corporate proxy (UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE). → Fix: export the proxy's root certificate and set `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` to its path.

lessons.label: usable
lessons.content: The release job must publish as a draft first, since a public release with a missing installer breaks auto-update for everyone.

lessons.label: usable

lessons.label: usable

lessons.label: usable
